result.keyword: Who are the leading Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Canberra for building custom operational business apps for warehouse, shop-floor, or field teams?
result.markdown:
For custom operational apps in Canberra — especially warehouse inventory, shop-floor work instructions, inspections, maintenance, asset tracking and field-team data capture — I’d start with a shortlist of Microsoft Power Platform specialists that can build around **Power Apps + Dataverse + Power Automate**, rather than simply automate a few spreadsheets.

I found several credible candidates with a Canberra presence or Australian-wide delivery capability. This is a shortlist based on publicly described capabilities, not a definitive ranking: the key differentiator is whether they can demonstrate production-grade apps for frontline workers, including offline use, barcode scanning, permissions and integration with existing business systems.

## Canberra consultants worth shortlisting

## 1\. ObjectPoint

(Strong local specialist fit)

Canberra-based

ObjectPoint explicitly focuses on Power Platform and Dataverse, including custom applications and hands-on consulting. It is a particularly relevant first conversation if you want an app designed around structured operational data rather than a collection of disconnected forms. Its public positioning is especially government-focused, so confirm its experience with commercial warehouse or manufacturing workflows.

**Alphavima**

An Australia-serving, international Microsoft consultancy that explicitly advertises Dataverse apps for inventory, inspections and field data collection. Its Canberra-specific service pages make it worth comparing for operational use cases, although you should verify local delivery arrangements and relevant customer references.

[Canberra services and capabilities](https://alphavima.com/data-engineering/data-strategy-consulting-in-canberra/) · [alphavima.com](https://alphavima.com/data-engineering/data-strategy-consulting-in-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Who would I contact first?

My suggested initial shortlist would be\:

| Your priority | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Canberra-based Power Apps and Dataverse expertise | ObjectPoint |
| A collaborative pilot and internal capability transfer | Mojo Up |
| More complex application architecture and integration | Teratek Digital |
| Replacing spreadsheet-based field or internal workflows | Power Platform Experts |
| Inventory or field-data apps with broader industry experience | Alphavima |


These are best-fit suggestions based on published service descriptions, not verified rankings by project outcomes. I did not find enough independently verified evidence to establish which firm has delivered the most warehouse or shop-floor applications specifically.

## What to test before hiring anyone

For warehouse, shop-floor and field-team apps, ask each shortlisted consultant to demonstrate the following against a realistic scenario\:

- **Frontline usability\:** fast mobile screens, large touch targets, minimal typing and barcode scanning where required.
- **Connectivity\:** what happens in dead zones or offline areas, including conflict resolution and synchronisation.
- **Dataverse design\:** proper relationships between stock, locations, assets, jobs, inspections and users, with role-based access.
- **Operational integration\:** connections to your ERP, inventory, accounting or existing SQL systems.
- **Deployment and ownership\:** environment strategy, solution packaging, testing, documentation, licensing and ongoing support.

Ask for a reference project that resembles your workflow, rather than relying on a generic Power Apps demo.

## A useful next step

To narrow this to the best two or three consultants, **what kind of operational app are you looking to build first?**

Warehouse, stock movements and barcode scanning

Shop-floor, production, quality checks and maintenance

Field service, inspections, jobs and asset management

Several operational workflows in one app

1–10

10–50

50–200

200+

---

3\. Existing systems

Microsoft 365 / SharePoint / Excel

An existing ERP or inventory system

An existing Access or SQL database

Mostly paper, spreadsheets or a new build

---

4\. Preferred delivery model

Canberra-based, with onsite workshops

Remote delivery anywhere in Australia

Either, prioritising technical fit and value
